title: skald store schema
description: Schema for the `.schema.toml` at the root of a skald ticket store. It declares that store's frontmatter contract: which keys exist, which are required, and the permitted values for each enum field. Stores are independent — a personal store's `spec`/`projects` and a work store's `linear`/`services` share no configuration and neither knows the other exists. skald owns the shape of a contract, never its contents.

template.description: Ticket template `skald new` scaffolds from, relative to the store root. The template — not this file — is the single source of truth for frontmatter key order.

keys.description: Declared frontmatter keys, by name. A key not declared here is an unknown key, and `skald check` reports it.

type.description: The value shape this key accepts.

oneOf.description: Exactly one bare value from `values`, with nothing appended. `review (pending Ian)` is a violation, never silently trimmed to `review`: the qualifier is information, so it is reported and the human moves it to the Build log.
An absolute http(s) URL, or empty. No annotations.
A list whose every item comes from `values`.

required.description: The key must be present. Presence and emptiness are separate concerns: `pr` is always present and usually empty.

allow_empty.description: Whether `key:` with nothing after it is acceptable. Defaults to true — an unfilled field is the normal state of a ticket mid-flight, not a violation. Set false for a key that must always carry a value, such as `phase`.

description.description: What this key means. Carried here so the contract is legible at the point of authoring.
